source_authority: Pre-Action Protocol for Debt Claims / Civil Procedure Rules

workflow.enforcement_note: High Court Enforcement Officers (HCEOs) or County Court Bailiffs

communication_templates.LEVEL_0: Courtesy reminder: Invoice {invoice_id} is due on {due_date}.
communication_templates.LEVEL_1: Friendly reminder: Invoice {invoice_id} remains open. If payment has already been made, please let us know.
communication_templates.LEVEL_2: Overdue notice: Invoice {invoice_id} is overdue. Current outstanding balance is £{principal_amount}.
communication_templates.LEVEL_3: Request for resolution: please confirm payment timing or provide a formal dispute update for Invoice {invoice_id}.
communication_templates.LEVEL_6: Client handoff: automated processing has ended for Invoice {invoice_id}. {instructions}
